item.title: How America's "truck-driver shortage" made the industry a hellscape
item.description:
📝 Key Takeaways: Senior trucking executives are only recently discovering an exponential influx of minimally trained foreign drivers and motor carriers, many operating with "non-domiciled CDLs" and little oversight. Nearly all say they only recently discovered the massive influx of foreign drivers and motor carriers. Small carriers and brokers were stuck with phone, fax, and leftover freight.
🔗 Read more: https://www.freightwaves.com/news/how-americas-trucking-industry-became-a-hellscape
